items.summary: perf(plugins): bound retained heap across runtime reloads (#166751) * perf(plugins): bound retained heap across runtime reloads Release retired registry and cache graphs held by inherited async scopes, closed schedulers, cancellation stacks, and lifecycle lease closures. Keep selected generations only through each admitted call or stream's lifetime, including nested calls under long-running consumers. Preserve adopted-owner runtime access, prepared selections, expired-lease refusals, and resolved plugin values while reducing reload heap retention. * fix(plugins): preserve pending scopes and runtime facade identity Keep direct registry-scope callbacks alive through their returned completion, then release custody so detached native resources cannot retain the registry. Reuse runtime namespace facades per source while selecting the current registry at invocation time. This preserves cold native-command authorization and Discord STT interception across runtime adoption and source replacement.

items.title: refactor(transcripts): move locked writes onto the worker owner (#165…
items.summary: refactor(transcripts): move locked writes onto the worker owner (#165921) * fix(sessions): preserve native rollback authority Keep prepared initialization rollback and opaque SDK deletion mutations on native planning and transaction paths. Ordinary host-minted binding participants retain worker execution and receipt settlement. Remove worker-only initialization finalizers and protect the same-store authority boundary with a real rollback regression. * test(sessions): retain rollback observer receiver * fix(sessions): settle accepted locked transcript appends Join accepted native lock operations in FIFO order before releasing the reservation, including callback failure and Gateway close. Preserve prepared receipt authority and its original cleanup receiver through harness adapters. Add awaited locked-message preparation with physical identity and fresh-insert version checks. Keep the released synchronous option deprecated and compatible, and migrate bundled catalog and Codex callers. No schema or durability change. * style(sessions): avoid shadowing transcript lock parameters * fix(sessions): prevent stale worker commit acknowledgments * refactor(transcripts): run locked writes through the worker owner Move durable locked transcript reads and mutations onto the existing history reader and agent writer. Retain physical identity, current source and custody authority, exact snapshots, FIFO settlement, and acknowledged publication. Keep released synchronous callbacks and admitted native scopes compatible. Preserve prepared replay, message suppression, frozen anchors, and host-only callback parameters across the worker boundary. No schema or retention change. * fix(transcripts): explicitly await retained lock cleanup * fix(transcripts): retain callback and refusal boundaries Remove nested preparation callbacks before worker preflight and preserve validated, redacted writer-refusal details through the worker error codec. Share the refusal parser with metadata transport without admitting arbitrary object causes. Join worker-backed fixture closure and keep SQLite fixture timestamps on a shared wall clock. Preserve all cleanup, FIFO, and replay assertions. Validation: 81 codec/owner tests, 13 CLI history tests, both original fixture failures, and 48 import/build-closure test results pass. Original codec fails three refusal-detail assertions. Core and affected test types pass; fresh P2 reviews of the full candidate and repair delta have no actionable findings. * test(transcripts): align fixtures with worker-owned writes Drain worker owners before removing database fixtures and explicitly close seed workers before cold-admission lease checks. Inject rollback faults on the worker connection and use the native writer for the test of same- connection cache identity. Keep the CLI test under its suite-owned state root. Preserve the existing rollback, privacy, cache, lease, and ordering assertions. The original state-fixture failures reproduce five times per file on the PR head and pass five times on the merge base. Focused repaired runtime proof is still in progress; affected types, lint, and independent P2 review pass. * perf(transcripts): retain worker reads and consolidate queries * perf(transcripts): advance mutation clocks in one statement * refactor(transcripts): keep snapshot checks with the reader * perf(transcripts): share the reconciliation status query * perf(transcripts): reuse the parent of anchored replays * docs(transcripts): clarify retained writer ownership * fix(transcripts): preserve readmission and reduce locked read queries * fix(sqlite): reuse admitted schema markers across readers * fix(transcripts): preserve worker read diagnostics and signal handling * fix(errors): match DNS failures outside generated path fragments * refactor(sessions): keep admitted key lookup in read owner
